subject: GreenWave: load-capacity alignment & dry-run slot
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwave.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@greenwave.ai>, GreenWave SRE <sre@greenwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Load verification + architecture deep-dive request

Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked what they saw and our SRE team wants to run a short capacity verification before we move to a POC schedule. High level ask: a 2-hour deep-dive that pairs architecture folks (your infra/runtime leads) with our SREs, and a 1-hour dry-run load window to validate token/sec targets and fallback behavior.

What we'd like to cover:
- Target sustained token throughput we should aim for (p50/p95 latency guardrails)
- Cold-start vs warm KV cache behavior and expected warmup time
- Model variants you recommend for cost/latency trade-offs
- Runbook for failure scenarios (auto-fallback to smaller variant, region failover)

Proposed windows this week: Wed 5/12 9–11 PT (deep-dive) + Thu 5/13 10–11 PT (dry-run), or next Tue 5/18 13–15 PT as an alternative.

I've attached a short requirements doc with our expected traffic profile.

(attachment: greenwave-requirements.pdf - 28KB)

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering | GreenWave Analytics
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Load verification + architecture deep-dive request

Tom —

Great, really appreciate the clear ask. We can absolutely pair engineering for a focused session. Quick notes / asks before we lock:
- Can you confirm target sustained tokens/sec (average) and peak burst size? Your requirements doc lists a 150k token/day number but not per-second distribution.
- Which region do you prefer for the dry-run? We can run in us-west1 (lowest latency for your fleet) or us-east1 if you need east coast routing.

I’m attaching our dry-run runbook draft and a benchmark canvas we use to map token targets to instance counts. If you can drop the load profile CSV we’ll pre-seed a synthetic traffic generator to match your shape.

Proposed booking: Wed 5/12 09:00–11:00 PT for the architecture deep-dive (Marcus + Karthik + Irene will attend), Thu 5/13 10:00–11:00 PT for the dry-run. If that doesn’t work, we can move both to Tue 5/18 13:00–15:00 PT. Please confirm.

(attachment: redwood-dryrun-runbook.docx - 45KB)
(attachment: redwood-benchmark-canvas.xlsx - 22KB)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwave.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 07:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Load verification + architecture deep-dive request

Tom / Vanessa —

A few technical clarifications so we can size the right slot: 
- For sustained throughput, are you targeting ~200 TPS (tokens/sec) or 2k TPS? The difference changes instance sizing by an order of magnitude. If you can provide a 1-minute granularity CSV (tokens/sec), we’ll map to instance groups.
- Which model family are you planning to exercise? We can run the dry-run against two model variants back-to-back (fp16 large vs int8 quantized) to show trade-offs; that requires a short warmup (~3–5m) for KV cache to see representative latency.
- Are you planning long context sessions (>2k tokens) or many short requests? Long contexts favor different batching behavior.

Operational ask: If SRE can give us a SIP to allow SSH access for telemetry collection (read-only) during the dry-run, we’ll include detailed perf traces in the post-mortem.

I’ve penciled Marcus (me), Karthik, and Irene onto Wed 9–11 PT. If you confirm the CSV, we’ll generate a synthetic pattern and share a token schedule.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenwave.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@greenwave.ai>, GreenWave SRE <sre@greenwave.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Load verification + architecture deep-dive request

Marcus —

Thanks — attaching the 1-min token/sec CSV and a short note on session types. We expect a steady-state average of 1,200 tokens/sec with 30% bursts up to ~1,600 tokens/sec for short windows; majority of requests are short (<256 tokens) but ~10% are long context analysis (~3k tokens). Model planned: open-llm/gw-suite-large (we can mirror to your infra).

SSH read-only access for telemetry is fine — I’ll loop in SRE to create a temporary key. Region preference: us-west1. Confirm Wed 5/12 and Thu 5/13 slots — we’ll treat Wed as architecture + planning and Thu as the dry-run (30m test + ramp + 30m steady + cool-down).

(attachment: greenwave-load-profile.csv - 16KB)

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Platform Engineering | GreenWave Analytics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
